violations.explanation: The custom button uses GestureDetector instead of a standard Material button. Semantics marks it as a button, and GestureDetector does expose a tap action, but the control is not focusable. It has no keyboard or switch-access activation (Enter/Space), no focus highlight, and no ink feedback. A standard ElevatedButton/FilledButton, or InkWell with focus support, would provide these automatically.
Semantics does not declare the enabled state (enabled: true). Assistive technologies may therefore not report the button as enabled. Standard buttons expose this state automatically.
